description: This file defines an immutable Java class `ImmutableResourceStatus` implementing the `ResourceStatus` interface. It models the status of a resource with properties such as resource type, client identifier, connectivity status, optional address, optional status details, and optional timestamp indicating when the resource entered the current state. The class includes factory methods for instantiation, JSON serialization/deserialization, and overrides for `equals`, `hashCode`, and `toString` methods.
